question: What bodily and perceptual powers result from mastery of this wheel?
premises: Wrinkles and grey hair are destroyed
Seeing from very far away is attained
These are presented as parallel results
inference: Mastery of this wheel brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair and the ability to see from very far away.
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
